premise: Maya does her morning stretches beside the oxygen plant, which seems to breathe in and out with her — and the buggy spins its wheels as if it were pedalling along.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Monkey and the Camel', where copying a dancer ends badly, turned: copying each other is the whole fun of the Moon's first exercise class.

en-US.title: Morning Stretches
en-US.text: Every morning, {woman:enter} Maya did her stretches out on the plain. {woman:hop} Reach up! Touch your toes! This morning she had company: the {oxygen-plant:enter} oxygen plant, busy making air for the base. {woman:face happy} {woman:says} [playfully] “Breathe in!” Maya took a big, deep breath. {oxygen-plant:live hold} {sfx:hum} The plant's oven glowed, and its gauges swung up, as if it were breathing in too! {woman:face surprised} [gasps] {woman:says} “And… breathe out.” {woman:wobble} {oxygen-plant:live resume} Slowly, its gauges swung back down. Then the {buggy:enter} buggy came rolling over to join in. {buggy:live} It spun its wheels round and round, right where it stood, as if it were pedalling a bicycle. [laughs] {woman:face happy} {woman:wobble x2} Maya laughed so hard she sat down in the dust. {woman:dust-puff} {oxygen-plant:pulse} {buggy:hop} [happily] And that was the very first exercise class on the Moon.

es-ES.title: Estiramientos de buena mañana
es-ES.text: Cada mañana, {woman:enter} Maya hacía sus estiramientos en la llanura. {woman:hop} ¡Brazos arriba! ¡Tocarse los pies! Esta mañana tenía compañía: la {oxygen-plant:enter} planta de oxígeno, ocupada fabricando aire para la base. {woman:face happy} {woman:says} [playfully] «¡Inspira!» Maya tomó aire, muy hondo. {oxygen-plant:live hold} {sfx:hum} El horno de la planta brilló y sus agujas subieron, ¡como si ella también inspirara! {woman:face surprised} [gasps] {woman:says} «Y… espira.» {woman:wobble} {oxygen-plant:live resume} Despacio, sus agujas volvieron a bajar. Entonces llegó el {buggy:enter} buggy para apuntarse. {buggy:live} Giró las ruedas sin moverse del sitio, como si pedaleara en una bicicleta. [laughs] {woman:face happy} {woman:wobble x2} Maya se rió tanto que se sentó en el polvo. {woman:dust-puff} {oxygen-plant:pulse} {buggy:hop} [happily] Y esa fue la primera clase de gimnasia de la Luna.
